news.title: Man who took bird from Las Vegas' Flamingo casino could face prison if convicted
news.summary: A jury has convicted a Canadian man of animal cruelty charges after the tourist drunkenly snatched a flamingo named Peachy from its enclosure at an iconic Las Vegas hotel during a visit in March
